subject: english
question: Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word: The legal scholar revised the **digest **of civil statutes.

options.text: He took a tablet to aid his digest after the meal.
The magazine's monthly digest reached a million readers.
The editor proofread the tax digest overnight.
The court referenced an old digest of maritime law.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"digest"** has multiple meanings depending on its context (a homonym).

 
 
• It can mean the process of breaking down food in the body (पाचन in Hindi).
 
• It can also refer to a compilation or summary of information, especially legal or written material (सारांश in Hindi).
 
 
 
• **Explanation of the given context:**
 
 
• In the sentence, "The legal scholar revised the **digest** of civil statutes," the word "digest" refers to a summary or compilation of legal statutes (सारांश).
 
 
 
• **Correct word in Option 1:**
 
 
• In Option 1, "He took a tablet to aid his digest after the meal," the word "digest" refers to the process of breaking down food in the body (पाचन).
 
• **Example:** After eating a heavy meal, he drank herbal tea to help with digestion.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** "The magazine's monthly digest reached a million readers."

 
 
• Here, "digest" refers to a publication containing a summary of news or information (सारांश).
 
• **Example:** The monthly digest provided concise updates on global politics.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "The editor proofread the tax digest overnight."
 
 
• Here, "digest" refers to a written summary or compilation of tax-related information (सारांश).
 
• **Example:** The tax digest included the latest updates in tax laws.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "The court referenced an old digest of maritime law."
 
 
• Here, "digest" refers to a summary or compilation of maritime laws (सारांश).
 
• **Example:** The historical digest of maritime law is often cited in legal cases.
 
 

3f:T959,

The correct answer is Option 2</stro
